text: Let yourself arrive in this new day.
Feel the support beneath your body.
Let your breathing find an easy rhythm.
Notice how you feel this morning.
What would you like to give your attention to today?
Choose one small thing that matters to you.
Imagine taking the first easy step.
Begin to notice the room around you.
Gently move your fingers and toes.
Let your eyes open at your own pace.
Carry that intention into your day.
